 View Comments Sunday will be mostly dry with a spot flurry or sprinkle possible. Boston Globe 
 Sunday is looking sunny with the morning in the upper 30s. Temperatures should approach 50 Sunday afternoon, with some wind. As long as the leaves are drying out, you’ll have a chance to rake some up, but those that are in the shade will definitely still have some moisture to them. 
 Highs on Sunday will hover between the upper 40s and the low 50s. Boston Globe A few spot flurries may fall across the mountains once again, but other than that, Sunday is the pick of the weekend. 
 Sunday night should remain clear in the 30s. 
 If you missed the chance to check out Mars, Jupiter, and Regulus before sunrise, you’ll have another chance Monday morning to check out the astronomical sight. 
 Start of next week looks nice with sunshine and seasonable temperatures. 
 The forecast across Boston for the next seven days. Boston Globe Weekend breakdown
 Greater Boston: Sunshine returns on Sunday with highs near 50. 
 Central and Western Mass.: It will be sunny on Sunday with high temperatures in the upper 40s to near 50. 
 Southeastern Mass.: Sunshine is back on Sunday with highs in the lower 50s. 
 Cape Cod and Islands: It’ll be in the low 50s on Sunday with sunshine. 
 Rhode Island: It will be 48 to 52 on Sunday as the sunshine returns. 
 New Hampshire: In the mid- to upper 40s on Sunday with sunshine returning.
